name: CUPRUM ARSENICOSUM
key_symptoms: Cardiac rhythm and force altered due to defective elimination.
Cramps in calves of legs, worse after midnight, only relieved by getting out of bed and standing. Ulcers; gangrene.
Persistent lameness. Pain in lumbar region and in lower left shoulder-blade; chest feels tight.
guiding_symptoms: Cardiac rhythm and force altered due to defective elimination.
Cramps in calves of legs, worse after midnight, only relieved by getting out of bed and standing. Ulcers; gangrene.
Persistent lameness. Pain in lumbar region and in lower left shoulder-blade; chest feels tight.
head_symptoms: Tongue thickly coated, dirty brown, white, metallic taste; thirst. Dry mouth.
gi_symptoms: Gastro-enteritis. Violent abdominal pain. Diarrhśa in phthisis. Cholera (Ars; Verat; Camph). Rumbling and sharp cutting pain. Dark liquid stools.
urinary_symptoms: Renal inefficiency and urćmia. Garlicky odor. Diabetes. Urine of high specific gravity; increased, acetones and diacetic acid.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Cramps in calves of legs, worse after midnight, only relieved by getting out of bed and standing. Ulcers; gangrene.
skin_symptoms: Icy cold. Sweat, and skin even when dry. Cold, clammy perspiration of an intermittent nature. Acne, pustules on face and in the cruro-genital region; ulcers look like chancre. Gangrene; carbuncles.
